The witching hour

It looks like play, but they're learning a future curriculum

The world your kid is growing into will lean on machines for the knowing. What sets them apart is the human stuff a screen can't teach, and it grows slowly, through play. Every activity here builds two or three of the eight strengths we've identified to be future essential for our minis.

Attention

Staying with something slow, and the patience that grows from it.

Curiosity

Asking the next question instead of taking the first answer.

Real world

Hands that know how things really work, by doing them.

Creativity

Making something new that is all their own.

Agency

Being the one who decides and makes things happen.

Connection

Reading a real face, sharing a real moment.

Discernment

Telling what's true from what only sounds true.

Sticking at it

Staying with something hard until it works.

Problem-solving and critical thinking run all the way through. See how it lines up with the Australian Curriculum ›

Frequently
asked questions

How much does Mini Brains Play cost?▲
It's free to download and browse. Full access to the whole library is a small monthly or yearly subscription, and you can cancel any time.
What kind of activities are included?▼
Screen-free play for toddlers and preschoolers: making, building, cooking, getting outside, calm wind-down games and quick five-minute rescues. Every idea is tagged by time, mess, age and the skill it grows.
Do I need to buy supplies for the activities?▼
Almost never. Nearly every idea uses what's already in the house: a few pegs, some tape, a cardboard box. No craft cupboard, no shopping list.
What age is Mini Brains Play for?▼
It's built for children aged 2 to 7. Age is a filter, not a wall, so you can dial any idea up or down to suit your kid.
How can an app be screen-free?▼
The app is only where you find the idea. You pick a moment, tap an activity, then the phone goes down and the playing happens off the screen, with your hands and whatever's around.
How do I find an activity quickly?▼
Pick the kind of day you're having, get outside, wind down, or rescue us at 5pm, and Mini Brains Play hands you ideas that fit the time, the mess and the energy you've got.
Is Mini Brains Play made in Australia?▼
Yes. It's made in Australia by an Aussie parent, for Aussie families, and the activities line up with the Australian Curriculum.
